# Phase Two — Failure Boundaries

- UI must not show Radiance if the server action is unavailable.
- UI must not invent its 25-credit cost; server testimony owns cost.
- Already-owned state must come from account entitlement testimony.
- Unlock button must preserve idempotency across retries.
- Successful unlock must refresh ownership and credit balance visibly.
- Failed unlock must not leave a false owned state.
- Theme application must remain readable in high contrast and reduced motion.
- Global styling must not break games/editors.
- Crawlable catalog generation must not replace runtime filtering/search.
- Every touched source remains exact-header, tab-indented, fully documented and <120 lines.
